queries.sentinel:
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated >= datetime(2026-09-10T13:39:54.156285+00:00)
| where AlertName == "Cloudflare - Bad client IP"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| project SystemAlertId, AlertName, AlertSeverity, Tactics, Entities, ExtendedProperties, ProductName, ProviderName, VendorName, AlertType, SourceSystem, TimeGenerated
queries.defender:
AlertInfo
| where Timestamp >= datetime(2026-09-10T13:39:54.156285+00:00)
| where Title == "Cloudflare - Bad client IP"
| join kind=leftouter (AlertEvidence | project AlertId, EvidenceRole, EntityType, RemoteIP, LocalIP, RemoteUrl, AccountUpn, DeviceId, AdditionalFields) on AlertId
| project AlertId, Title, Severity, Category, AttackTechniques, ServiceSource, DetectionSource, EntityType, EvidenceRole, RemoteIP, LocalIP, RemoteUrl, AccountUpn, DeviceId, AdditionalFields, Timestamp
